description: Login redesign + Forgot Password + credential-gated social login (all build-safe, no new mobile dep) and a one-line server hardening. Redesign app/login.tsx premium/on-brand keeping ALL existing logic and bilingual copy; add a Forgot Password flow wired to the closest EXISTING server endpoint with a mandatory warning for the missing reset endpoint; add three credential-gated social buttons with a mandatory warning for the missing OAuth prerequisites; add express-async-errors as the first server import and guard the two unguarded order list reads. Covers plan.md items 11,12,13,14. Independent of FEAT-001/002 except that items 11-13 all edit app/login.tsx (one file).
steps: app/login.tsx (item 11 redesign): wrap the form in a branded header using AnimatedGradient + warmGradient (src/components/ui.tsx / src/theme.ts) with the 4A Store logo (reuse the asset StoreHeader uses, or assets/images/icon.png), using space/radius tokens and the gradient primary button. Polish the Login/Create-account toggle and spacing with the existing Field/PasswordField/GradientButton. Keep KeyboardAvoidingView and do NOT change doLogin, sendOtp, doRegister, done() (registerForPush on done), the email-OTP register flow, or any state. Keep bilingual copy.

app/login.tsx (item 12 Forgot Password): add a 'Forgot password? / पासवर्ड भूल गए?' link in login mode that opens an email -> OTP -> new-password reset UI (a new mode:'forgot' branch or sibling form). PROVEN BY CODE (api-node/src/routes/users.ts + otp.ts): there is NO password-reset endpoint and the recovery-email OTP endpoints (/users/recovery-email/send,/verify) require requireAuth (logged-in only); /otp/send is a PUBLIC signup-purpose OTP. So wire the OTP-send to the closest PUBLIC endpoint (POST /otp/send) and clearly LABEL (bilingual) that password reset is pending backend support so nothing silently appears to work. Do NOT invent an endpoint. BEFORE finishing, call send_message severity 'warning' naming the missing endpoint POST /users/reset-password {email,otp,newPassword} and that recovery OTP endpoints are auth-gated; wait for the answer.

app.config.ts + src/config.ts (item 13 setup): add extra.googleClientId/facebookAppId/instagramAppId to app.config.ts extra, each defaulting to '' from process.env (STORE4A_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, STORE4A_FACEBOOK_APP_ID, STORE4A_INSTAGRAM_APP_ID); expose them from src/config.ts. (extra is an open record so no new tsc error.)

app/login.tsx (item 13 social buttons): add three build-safe buttons — Google (white + 'G'), Facebook (#1877F2), Instagram (gradient via AnimatedGradient/offerGradient) — using emoji/text only (NO icon font / native dep). Read the client IDs from src/config.ts; if a provider's ID is empty, tapping shows a per-provider toast like 'Google login setup pending — admin se contact karein' and does nothing. Buttons MUST render and never crash with empty credentials. Do NOT add expo-auth-session/expo-web-browser (build risk) and do NOT build the OAuth round-trip (the POST /users/social-login endpoint does not exist). BEFORE finishing, call send_message severity 'warning' listing prerequisites: OAuth client IDs (Google/Facebook/Instagram) + a POST /users/social-login {provider,token,profile} server endpoint; wait for the answer.
api-node/src/server.ts (item 14a): add `import 'express-async-errors';` as the VERY FIRST line, before `import './systemCa';`.
api-node/package.json (item 14b): add "express-async-errors": "3.1.1" (EXACT, Express-4 compatible) to dependencies; run npm install so it resolves.

api-node/src/routes/orders.ts (item 14c): wrap BOTH unguarded list reads in try/catch so a Prisma rejection returns fast instead of hanging — the staff branch `const orders = await prisma.order.findMany({ orderBy:{id:'desc'} })` and the customer branch `const orders = await prisma.order.findMany({ where, orderBy:{id:'desc'} })`. On failure return a fast response (e.g. return fail(res,'Could not load orders',500)). Do NOT change the success response shape ok(res,{orders}), tracking, rider, or payments.
acceptance_criteria: cd 4astore-v2/mobile; npx tsc --noEmit prints ONLY the known app.config.ts(39) usesCleartextTraffic error (the new extra keys add no new error).

cd 4astore-v2/api-node; npm install; npx tsc --noEmit error count does NOT exceed the 84-error untyped-Prisma baseline and NO 'Cannot find module express-async-errors' error appears (package ships its own types). If prisma generate can run, baseline is 0 and no new errors.
login.tsx keeps KeyboardAvoidingView and doLogin/sendOtp/doRegister/done() unchanged; bilingual copy retained; branded AnimatedGradient header present.
A 'Forgot password?' link renders in login mode; the reset form calls only existing endpoints (no invented endpoint) and shows a 'pending backend' bilingual label; the item-12 warning was sent.
Three social buttons render with empty credentials and show the per-provider 'setup pending' toast; no new mobile dependency added; the item-13 warning was sent.
server.ts first import is express-async-errors; both order list reads in orders.ts are inside try/catch returning a fast response; response shapes unchanged.
verification: cd c:/xampp/htdocs/static4a/.worktrees/app-slow-loaders-login/4astore-v2/mobile; npm install; npx tsc --noEmit  (expect ONLY the app.config.ts usesCleartextTraffic error)
cd c:/xampp/htdocs/static4a/.worktrees/app-slow-loaders-login/4astore-v2/api-node; npm install; npx tsc --noEmit  (expect error count <= 84 untyped-Prisma baseline; express-async-errors resolves)
Read login.tsx and confirm the three auth handlers + done() are unchanged, KeyboardAvoidingView present, forgot-password + social buttons render and are credential/endpoint-safe.
Confirm the two mandatory send_message warnings were issued (item 12 and item 13).
Read server.ts (first import) and orders.ts (both findMany reads guarded).
findings: DONE. (1) Login redesign: branded AnimatedGradient hero (icon.png + warmGradient) added; KeyboardAvoidingView kept; doLogin/sendOtp/doRegister/done() unchanged; bilingual copy retained; Field/PasswordField/GradientButton reused. (2) Forgot Password: parent APPROVED building the real flow end-to-end (not a pending toast). Added TWO new PUBLIC server endpoints in api-node/src/routes/users.ts, reusing the EmailOtp table (purpose='reset', 10-min expiry) + existing sendMail: POST /users/forgot-password/send {identifier} (username|mobile|email; enumeration-safe generic 200) and POST /users/reset-password {identifier,otp,newPassword} (verifies OTP, bcrypt-hashes password, syncs plain_password via raw SQL, revokes refresh tokens, 422 on bad/expired code, min-4 password via zod). Mobile forgot UI wired to both; on success returns to login prefilled; 'no email? contact store 7543888698' helper added; bilingual. The auth-gated recovery-email endpoints were NOT touched. (3) Social login: parent CONFIRMED the credential-gated fallback. Three build-safe buttons (Google/Facebook/Instagram) render with NO new mobile dep; empty client ID shows per-provider 'setup pending' toast. Client IDs added to app.config.ts extra + src/config.ts (STORE4A_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/STORE4A_FACEBOOK_APP_ID/STORE4A_INSTAGRAM_APP_ID). (4) Server hardening: `import 'express-async-errors'` is now the first import in server.ts; express-async-errors 3.1.1 pinned in package.json (installed, resolves); both order list findMany reads in orders.ts wrapped in try/catch returning fail(res,'Could not load orders',500); success shape ok(res,{orders}) unchanged. FOLLOW-UP (social activation, not built now, owner to enable later): provision OAuth client IDs (Google client ID, Facebook app ID, Instagram app ID) via the STORE4A_* env vars, and add a POST /users/social-login {provider,token,profile} server endpoint to exchange the token and issue a session. VERIFY: mobile tsc = only the known app.config.ts(39) usesCleartextTraffic error; server tsc = 84 (unchanged untyped-Prisma baseline), no new codes/files, no 'Cannot find module express-async-errors'.
